verdict.rationale: A first-party GST Developer Portal exists at developer.gst.gov.in with Register and Login entry points, which suggests a published enrollment path for software to access the service programmatically. The evidence is only a bare home-page snippet, and nothing describes what the API covers, how system accounts or intermediary/batch providers are onboarded, or the approval steps. The Offline Tool and GST Practitioner enrollment are adjacent features (offline upload and human intermediaries), not machine-to-machine rails, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: documented API scope and transaction coverage, system-account or credential provisioning details, an intermediary or transmitter-provider program and its enrollment steps, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
